projects.name: Skypro IPTV
details: Technologies: core Java, Spring boot, Microservice, Angular 14, PostgreSQL, RESTful Web Services
Description: Skypro TV is an IPTV application offering live streaming of multilingual channels, enhancing the entertainment
experience. The service operates seamlessly with the Skypro Network. Key contributions include:
• Set-Top Box (STB) Management: APIs for creating, updating STBs, and managing channel subscriptions.
• Payment Integration: Integrated Easy Buzz for secure and efficient payment processing.
• Customer Service Chatbot: Developed an end-user chatbot enabling direct channel subscriptions and payments,
enhancing user convenience. This project focuses on delivering a streamlined live TV and customer service experience.
Protean e-Governance Technologies pvt ltd. | New Delhi

projects.name: Agristack Project
details: Technologies: Core Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Angular, PostgreSQL, AWS.
Description: Worked on the AgriStack platform, focusing on supporting registry management and network administration
functionalities. Developed backend microservices using Spring Boot to deliver scalable, secure APIs and collaborated with the
front-end team to implement user-friendly interfaces using Angular. Ensured seamless integration and efficient management of
agricultural data systems.
• Developed and supported AgriStack, focusing on registry management and network administration.
• Built and maintained backend microservices using Spring Boot, ensuring scalable and secure APIs.\
• Collaborated on front-end development with Angular to provide a user-friendly interface for registry and network
management functions.
